newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says Freeport review extended.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says Freeport review extended.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday that the time period for the due diligence review of the Busang gold project by Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc has been extended to June 30.
Bre-X said in a statement that the extension was made at the request of Freeport-McMoRan to allow for consideration of an independent audit of the project by Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd.
Strathcona is expected to deliver its report to Bre-X on Thursday or Friday. Bre-X has said it will issue a press release on the report before North American financial markets open on Monday.

"The time period for the due diligence review being conducted by Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc (FCX) of the Busang properties has been extended to June 30, 1997, at the request of FCX, to allow for consideration of the findings of the Strathcona audit," the statement said.
Freeport spokeswoman Kristin Lemkau said on Wednesday the New Orleans-based miner requested the extension to allow for the completion of the audit by Strathcona.

Strathcona has said its final report to Bre-X would be delivered about six weeks after the interim report. Strathcona has said the principal conclusions in the interim report were not expected to differ from the final report.

"The original agreement with Bre-X signed on February 26 said that FCX's due diligence expire on April 30. This is really just to announce that we had pushed that date to June 30 to allow time for completion of the independent audit by Strathcona," Lemkau said in a telephone interview.
She said Freeport's request for an extension was made within the last week.
